insight: Co-founded by the Caper AI team that earlier sold its AI smart-cart startup to Instacart for ~$350M.
name: Dyna Robotics
tagline: Commercial robot foundation models for autonomous, round-the-clock dexterity.
description: Dyna Robotics builds general-purpose robots powered by DYNA-1, an embodied AI foundation model aimed at commercial-grade, fully autonomous dexterity. In a public demo, DYNA-1 folded 800+ napkins over a continuous 24-hour run at a reported 99.4% success rate with no human intervention. The Redwood City company targets restaurant, grocery, and other service deployments.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary embodied AI foundation model for dexterous manipulation.

edge: Pitched as the first commercial-ready robot foundation model — DYNA-1 ran 24h of autonomous folding at a reported 99.4% success rate.
pros: Founders sold prior startup to Instacart
Backed by CRV, First Round, Salesforce
cons: Narrow demonstrated task set so far
Early commercial traction vs big claims
